propositions: The cross-gate cutover must be guarded by a deterministic shadow comparator that reports only approved deltas (effective retune/disable, project DET inclusion, project LLM applicability, budget enforcement, typed partial-failure, success-only checkpointing) and never issues model calls or controls final verdict.

A repository-policy/contract guard must prevent review gates from bypassing CriteriaSnapshot, introducing a second discovery scheduler outside the shared kernel, or adding per-unit trace fields to review/review-status schemas.

Live external provider canary must exercise the real default discovery path, assert narrow final verdicts (PASS/BLOCK) with coverage.llm_ran=True and sidecar_emitted=True, and print no secrets or prompt/trace bodies.

Documentation must establish final ownership (gate-owned topology/strategy, shared snapshot/execution facts, RP-01 owns retry, rollback via code revert) and clarify that new code ignores legacy checkpoints and legacy projection never writes new journal.

The external-provider-matrix exercised all three real provider arms (anthropic, openai, bedrock) with >=1 discovery call/arm reaching the configured provider, all canary assertions passed, and cross-gate cutover is proven at the provider boundary.
